shortDescription: Create and manage Storage Boxes in Hetzner.

options.name: access_settings
options.description: Access settings of the Storage Box.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: delete_protection
options.description: Protect the Storage Box from deletion.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Storage Box to manage. Required if no Storage Box O(name) is given. If the ID is invalid, the module will fail.

options.name: labels
options.description: User-defined labels (key-value pairs) for the Storage Box.

options.name: location
options.description: Name or ID of the Location for the Storage Box. Required if the Storage Box does not exist.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Storage Box to manage. Required if no Storage Box O(id) is given. Required if the Storage Box does not exist.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the Storage Box. Required if the Storage Box does not exist.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Snapshot ID or Name to rollback to. Only used when O(state=rollback_snapshot)

options.name: snapshot_plan
options.description: Snapshot plan of the Storage Box. Use null to disabled the snapshot plan.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: SSH public keys in OpenSSH format to inject into the Storage Box.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Storage Box. C(reset_password) and C(rollback_snapshot) are not idempotent.

options.name: storage_box_type
options.description: Name or ID of the Storage Box Type for the Storage Box. Required if the Storage Box does not exist.
